description: This file defines the DumpAnalysis class used for analyzing Windows minidump files in unit tests, including methods for checking streams, memory, TEBs, and PEBs.

classes.name: FakeTEB
classes.description: A mock structure representing the Thread Environment Block (TEB) with a pointer to the Process Environment Block (PEB).

classes.name: DumpAnalysis
classes.description: A class for analyzing dump files, providing methods to access streams, check memory regions, and verify the presence of TEBs and PEBs.

methods.name: DumpAnalysis
methods.description: Constructor that initializes dump file analysis with a given file path.

methods.name: HasStream
methods.description: Checks if a specific stream exists in the dump.

methods.name: GetStream
methods.description: Template method to retrieve a specific stream from the dump.

methods.name: HasTebs
methods.description: Checks for the presence of TEBs in the dump.

methods.name: HasPeb
methods.description: Checks for the presence of PEB in the dump.

methods.name: HasMemory
methods.description: Checks if a memory address exists in the dump, overloads for different address types.

methods.name: EnsureDumpMapped
methods.description: Ensures the dump file is memory-mapped for analysis.

methods.name: HasMemoryImpl
methods.description: Implementation detail for checking memory presence.
